key_findings: Intradiscal LPS in rat caudal discs raises Tnfa, Il1b, Cgrp, Ngf, Bdnf expression, drives macrophage infiltration, disc degeneration and local mechanical hyperalgesia without puncture.
CGRP-positive PGP9.5 neurons appeared in LPS-injected discs, suggesting nociceptor ingrowth and sensitization.
